{{Top}}
The '''womb''' was the organ in the lower body of some [[Gender/Legends|female]] animals where offspring were [[Reproduction/Legends|conceived]] and in which they developed before birth.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> While gestating in their [[Parent/Legends|mother's]] womb, the child gave her a distinctive shape accompanied by a significant weight gain.<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> Most [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]], including [[Human/Legends|Humans]], bore their children live from the womb. The [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Yevetha]] reproduced by laying [[Egg/Legends|eggs]] in external wombs called [[mara-nas]].<ref name="NEGAS" />
